measurement: Choose your replacement part using the Size and Option buttons. Standard frame length is recommended for patients 5 ft 5 in. to 6 ft 4 in. tall. Short frame length is recommended for patients under 5 ft 5 in. tall. Check whether your brace has a SmartDosing dial or a dosing ratchet before ordering a strap kit, because the two versions use different straps. The DFS Strap Kit, Standard fits standard length SmartDosing frames. The DFS Strap Kit, Short and the Strap and Pad Kit, Short fit short length SmartDosing frames. The Ratchet Strap and Pad Kit fits standard length frames with the dosing ratchet. The Popliteal Pad, Standard fits standard length frames and the Popliteal Pad, Short fits short length frames. The Condyle Pad, Liner Twist Fit Attachment Kit, Keyhole Caps and Hinge Arm Screw fit all Unloader One frames, sizes XS through XL. No part in this listing is side specific, so the same part fits a left or a right brace. The Unloader One brace is not included. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
